title: PIT FIRE CERAMICS with Leslie Harris
source_quote: Sep 14 2026 September 14 @ 9:00 am - September 18 @ 12:00 pm PIT FIRE CERAMICS with Leslie Harris (a.m.)
evidence_sentence: The page lists PIT FIRE CERAMICS as a hand-building class exploring pit fired ceramics.
evidence_quote: This hand-building clay class offers an exploration into pit fired ceramics, an ancient method of "baking" clay in a pit fire to produce unpredictable designs, spectacular colors, smoky variations and textural imprints.
summary: A past pit firing workshop at The Art Barge (Sept 14–18, 2026) that taught hand-building and pit firing techniques for $400.
